title: Add PreCompact/PostCompact beads hooks for Claude Code

title: Extract playtest findings from AGENTS.md into their own doc
description: AGENTS.md is 772 lines; its Voice section and subsections are 183 of them (Measured and worth keeping, Combat narration, The opening, Since fixed, Known unfixed, Carried out of M2, Carried out of M3). These are playtest findings, not rules — they are observations with dates, and they keep growing one milestone at a time. Moving them to docs/playtest-findings.md would cut AGENTS.md by roughly a quarter and give the findings somewhere to accumulate without diluting the rules. Needs a judgement call about which findings have hardened into rules and should stay behind.
